title: Her rooms on the Boat deck (its houses): R3, a sourced table of facts
written: 2026-11-20, by the R3 session (Claude Opus 5.5), under docs/research/RESEARCH_rooms_plans_licence_v1_1_2026-11-20.md, on the coordinator's word after D deck and the orlop
rules: Facts only: which room, where, how big, which door to which. No image or drawing of any plan is kept. Every row cites the reference read and the original checked, or says it was not checked. Bets are tagged as bets.
reference: ET: Encyclopedia Titanica's free deck plans, the Boat deck (https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-deckplans/boat-deck.html; drawn by Bruce Beveridge for Titanic The Ship Magnificent, The History Press 2008), read on the page in the built-in browser on 2026-11-20, nothing saved
original: Shipbuilder 1911: The Shipbuilder, Midsummer 1911 (the Olympic and Titanic number), its plate of the Boat deck, as reproduced by GG Archives (https://www.ggarchives.com/OT/Titanic/25-ImageLibrary/TheShipbuilder-10-Design-SpecialPlates.html); too small to read room by room, not opened this time.
how: Walls by her frames, as on C, B and A decks: the plan's scale from its own frame ticks (30.8 px a frame: 0.0975 ft a pixel), the midship section placed by its printed 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 aft and 6, 8 and 10 forward, a ruler of her frames drawn over the page. Walls read against the ruler at 1:2, to about a frame; the houses' sides to about a foot.
Frames to feet: E deck's anchors (data/rooms/E_deck.json).
y: feet from the centreline, port positive, at 0.0979 ft a pixel. No row stands on her side: every row is a house, and its walls are numbers.

Rows: the enclosed houses and their rooms. The raised roofs over the smoke room and the lounge (about a metre over the deck), the domes over the two staircases, the compass platform and the open navigating bridge are not rooms and have no rows; the model counts the two raised roofs as houses 1.0 m high (TIER.houses).
No watertight bulkhead reaches the Boat deck; the table's bulkheads is empty.
Doors: 2 ft 3 in by default [bet]; the plan writes none on this deck. Stairs are listed among the doors with no width.
Derived fields (x_m, y_m, poly_m, area_m2, zone, slab, plan_compartment) are written by: node tools/rooms_table.js --write data/rooms/Boat_deck.json

frames.note: E deck's anchors (her frames, feet forward of amidships).

bulkheads.note: None: no watertight bulkhead reaches the Boat deck, and the reference marks none.
